card.name: Gap before serum potassium or sodium values
card.fires_on: The space or small linking word right after "serum potassium" or "serum sodium" and before a threshold number such as <5.0 or >5.7. It also fires on commas or "of" after potassium supplements or elevation.

modes.label: Before lab cutoff
modes.description: Space or comparison sign after serum potassium/sodium, just before a mEq/L threshold.
modes.example: the incidence of hyperkalemia (serum potassium<< >>>5.7 mEq/L)

modes.label: After potassium wording
modes.description: Comma or "of" in drug-interaction text where another potassium item is expected next.
modes.example: with potassium supplements<<,>> potassium salt substitutes, or potassium-sparing

card.writes: It pushes the model toward naming potassium or sodium next, as in repeated lists of potassium items.
card.plain: It marks the spot in lab-value text where potassium or sodium is about to be mentioned or a cutoff number follows.
